name: host-terminal
description: Use real host terminal sessions shared with the Host Terminal Chrome extension.

interface.shortDescription: Your host terminal, shared with Chrome
interface.longDescription: Run commands and work with interactive terminal sessions through the Host Terminal Chrome extension. Requires Node.js 22 or later, the extension and native host, and ChatGPT access explicitly enabled in Chrome.
defaultPrompt: List my Host Terminal sessions and help me with my project.
Run a command in a new Host Terminal session and show me its output.
